g.text: Global reorientation rate across physical cue distance and size

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Exact native right-hand side at cue-on time t=0 · 129 prescribed placements · all initial footprint classes retained

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Markers classify the complete initial cue support against the interpolated 10%-contrast edge; centre membership is separately reported.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: All 129 rates are observed with R ≥ 0.1 at this instant. Lines guide the eye between tested positions; no continuous-distance fit is asserted.

g.text: The rate is activity-vector phase change, not local-peak speed. Initial projection, current moment magnitude and native organization all contribute.
